claim: Public distribution (Manage Distribution, Activate Public Distribution) lets other workspaces install your app and does not require Slack Marketplace review. A Marketplace listing is a separate step and does add a review.
notes: Verified against official Slack documentation (https://api.slack.com/start/distributing). Public distribution is self-serve; Marketplace review is only required for App Directory/Marketplace listing.

claim: Apps do not need Slack review or approval to be installed on development or private workspaces.
notes: Tested in development workspace. Internal installations take effect immediately upon manifest upload.

claim: Sensitive scopes (verification review, no security assessment, review can take up to about 10 days) and Restricted scopes (verification plus an annual assessment by a Google approved assessor, repeated at least every 12 months, takes several weeks).
notes: Verified against official Google Identity documentation: sensitive scopes do not require security assessment; restricted scopes (such as full Gmail access) require an annual assessment by a Google approved assessor, repeated at least every 12 months.

claim: Creating and verifying an OAuth app requires a GCP project with billing enabled and allows up to 100 test users before submission.
notes: Could not confirm requirement for billing enabled or 100 test users limit in official production-readiness verification documentation.

claim: Slack bot tokens can dynamically request incremental scopes at runtime without workspace re-authorization.
notes: Corrected from initial draft: Slack strictly enforces bot scopes granted at install time. Adding new scopes requires prompting the user to re-authorize.

claim: Notion does not require manual app review or verification to enable public OAuth.
notes: Tested public distribution toggle. Providing valid HTTPS redirect URI and privacy policy URLs enabled public OAuth immediately.

claim: Notion plans to introduce a mandatory manual review queue for all public integrations.
notes: Community rumor. No official statement from Notion engineering confirming an approval queue as of Q4 2026.

claim: OAuth applications created via workspace settings have instant availability without manual review waits.
notes: Registered test application in workspace settings; client credentials generated and active immediately for testing.
